violations.text: Minestrone soup and chicken white bean soup, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Person in charge voluntarily disposed of food at the time of inspection. Cooling procedures reviewed with person in charge. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

Various food items were observed held at 50-55 degrees Fahrenheit at the deli cold line. Temperature display of the cold line was at 45 degrees Fahrenheit at the time of inspection. Foods placed in unit under 2 hours prior to inspection. Foods moved to walk-in cooler to rapidly cool. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2026

Prepackaged salads and sandwiches was observed held at 44-45 degrees Fahrenheit in the open air coolers. Coolers are to have less product kept in them to promote proper airflow. Ambient air temperature of coolers observed at 41 degrees Fahrenheit. Foods were prepped under 4 hours prior to inspection and moved to walk-in cooler to rapidly cool. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Chicken, brussels sprouts, and broccoli was placed hot in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Foods were moved to shallow pans to properly cool. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2026

The deli cold rail unit was observed to be in poor repair (not maintaining temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit). Person in charge contacted maintenance to repair unit. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2026

Baked goods packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 03/21/2024
